newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nera Asian unit launches satellite phone.
newsitem.headline: Nera Asian unit launches satellite phone.

text.p: Nera (SEA) Pte Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Norwegian communications company Nera ASA launched on Wednesday a 2.3 kg satellite global phone.
The Nera WorldPhone, a mobile satellite communications system, will allow users to make phone calls and send faxes from anywhere in the world, the company said in a statement.
It said the phone has a built-in satellite antenna that helps the user search for the nearest INMARSAT satellite, the only global satellite communications network in operation.

Nera, which has a primary listing on the Oslo bourse and a secondary listing on NASDAQ in New York, recently obtained in-principle approval to list its shares on the main board of Singapore's stock exchange.
